race.comment: MIKE'S HOPE (10) should be suited to racing beyond a mile for the first time here, and he caught the eye with a big late finish for second over a mile 4 weeks ago at Swan Hill. Each way. CROWN OF RUSSIA (9) was a beaten favourite at Kilmore just over 3 weeks ago when not much went his way. He is worth another chance, so follow your money. LUNAR FORCE (4) improved quickly second up when finishing third at Geelong, and he will be at his peak now. Stick with him on an each-way basis. SOUND OF JURA (2) won at Swan Hill in a similar field last time out, and only has to carry an extra 2kg here. Stick with him. BIRATU (8) drops back in trip, and class for this, so include him on all quaddie tickets.
